Computes a source pointer from a 2D layout (base this[6], per-column pitch this[1044], per-row pitch this[1045]), iterates this[1046] texels reading 2 packed bytes each, scales each 4-bit nibble by the 1/15 constant at flt_5AC108 (0.06666667), writes three color floats plus a 1.0 alpha per texel, then optionally invokes the callee at 0x00507845 when flag this[4] is set.

When flag this[4] (this+0x10) is nonzero, perform the trailing cleanup call.
Call the callee at 0x00507845 (named ContactManifoldCleanup) with this as the first argument and the start of the written float buffer (a4 minus 4 * this[1046] floats) as the second.
